bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 跳空跌破 $140，深度超卖

read.en: Nvidia fell 14.0% on Nov 20 to $125.53, its lowest close since May 12, 2025, trading $124.51–143.73 (a new 52-week low) on 2.39x average volume. It is below the 5-day ($146.8), 10-day ($158.4), 30-day ($193.8), 100-day ($209.8) and 200-day ($203.4), all falling. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($159.70), and RSI is 15.0, deeply oversold.
read.zh: 英伟达 11月20日下跌 14.0%，收于 $125.53，为 2025年5月12日以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $124.51–143.73，创 52 周新低，成交放量（为 20 日均量的 2.39 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$146.8）、10 日（$158.4）、30 日（$193.8）、100 日（$209.8）和 200 日均线（$203.4）下方，均在下行。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$159.70），RSI 为 15.0，深度超卖。

read.en: The stock gapped through all three written supports, $140.5–144.7 (June 2025 lows and closes), now resistance. Resistance is $126.9–129.5 (December 2024 and May 2025 lows), then $131.8–133.8 and $140.9–143.7 (Nov 20 high). Support is $122.9–124.5 (Nov 20 low, May 12, 2025 close), then $115–116.3 and $110.8–111.9 (2025 swing points). A close above $129.5 would target $131.8–133.8; below $122.9, $115–116.
